posts.body_html:
I have been buying plants from Mike for several years. Whenever ‘buying season’ begins for me, this thread is always the first stop I make. Mike’s plants are clean, pest free, very healthy, and always ‘as described’. This is the most reliable seller of Sarracenia that I know of, and his selection is huge, absolutely unrivaled!

Mike never fails to give incredibly detailed advice and suggestions. If you let him know what you’re looking for in terms of particular traits, breeding projects, etc. Mike will hook you up. I’m impressed by his generosity too, Mike always sends a freebie with my orders, and often I’m blown away by how freaking awesome it is. The plants I didn’t intend to receive from him often end up being favorites in my collection.

I can’t recommend Mike and his plants enough, but I’m guessing I’m preaching to the choir here!

posts.body_html: I finally built myself a Sarr table a couple of weeks ago which allowed me some space to acquire some new Sarrs!  I am primarily a Nepenthes grower and only dabble in Sarrs, and thus need to be very selective in what I buy.  I was in the market for select Sarrs and other growers highly recommended Mike Wang so I reached out!  I was impressed by Mike's ability to make spot on recommendations tailored to my specific tastes (tubby pitchers, lots of venation, lots of red color, etc), and he was incredibly patient throughout the whole process. When the plants arrived I was pleased to find several bonus plants that were also perfectly in line with my tastes!  I definitely look forward to buying more Sarrs from Mike in the future!
